working_definition: Glial cells (repo+) of the wandering third instar larval optic lobe; the authors do not subdivide them by glial subtype.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Glial cell of the late embryo/larva.

justification: The authors label the clusters simply 'glial cell'; the tissue is larval optic lobe. FBbt has no general larval optic lobe glial cell term (only a larval optic lobe A-subperineurial glial cell, flagged as possibly non-existent, and larval medulla/marginal glial subtypes), so the stage-appropriate generic larval glial cell is exact for label plus stage and not narrowed further.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: A supporting cell of the nervous system.

Larval glial cell that arises from the DL1 neuroblast and migrates to the optic anlage, where it differentiates into a more specific glial cell type in the vicinity of the developing medulla (Plazaola-Sasieta et al., 2019).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: A specific subtype; authors do not subdivide their glia.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00001251 larval glial cell (exact).
